name: APTARGRP INC.  DL-,01
summary: Aptargroup Inc. is a global leader in dispensing and sealing solutions for a broad range of end markets, including beauty, personal care, home care, prescription drug, consumer health care, injectables, food, and beverage. The company manufactures dispensing pumps, closures, and other packaging components. Aptargroup Inc. is headquartered in Crystal Lake, Illinois.
